name: pf-mod-architect-challenges
about: mod-architect-challenges against the built package coop instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). mods/architect challenges: the seven HoH1 bad-wish challenges load as free architect alterations; each takes a fixed gold + material amount off the bill after vanilla's cost curve, and a material stops at 0 (never pays out). Picked for a run (hwp architect try, the loadout Play's effect), the generation ones reach the floor (Crowded Halls + Champions set on the enemy placer) and the picks are on the player record. Then no script errors in our files.
